messages:
devon: Morning team — async check-in for early shift.

Did: rotated KV-cache nodes to shift load, ran quick latency bench for model-serving, and deployed a small alert-filter tweak to reduce noise.
Blocker: seeing intermittent alert spikes for the quantizer-worker job (alerts jumping ~3x for ~2m windows). Haven't pinned down whether it's batching or a kernel degeneration.
Today: will run a longer trace across the 1:00-2:00am window, add more metrics around batch size, and open a PR with a temporary threshold change if spikes persist.

maria: thx devon. can you link the trace when you have it? also FYI i saw a related pager last night (INC-6782) that had similar pattern — might be same root cause.

alex: pinging for a quick review on the threshold PR when it's up — i can merge and cut a small canary if oncall agrees. :+1:

devon: will do. rough PR draft coming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/482 — it's just a metric filter and config bump.

lina: heads up — oncall will be handing over at 0900 UTC. if you plan to change thresholds, please add a note to the handoff doc so the next shift knows why spikes drop.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for commit 3f8a2b7 to staging (serving:alert-filter).

maria: if spikes continue after the config, we should enable additional sampling for KV eviction logs — those were sparse last night. devon, can you add a small logging flag behind a feature flag?

devon: yes will add feature flag `sre.kv_eviction_sample=true` and flip post-canary. sample snippet i'll add:

```yaml
features:
  sre.kv_eviction_sample: true
```

alex: quick question — are we sure quantizer-worker is the only service impacted? i saw a tiny bump in the batcher too. can we add a short span tag so traces show service path?

devon: good call, i'll add `span.tag("batcher_path", route)` to the trace wrapper.

maria: cool. i can take the handoff notes later and add links to INC-6782 + PR 482 + the new flag. will also schedule a 15min post-mortem if we still see >2 spikes tonight.

lina: thanks — if anything urgent pops, @here. otherwise i'll watch the canary and post status at 0900. :eyes:
